delete.summary: Moves a database to the seven-day deleted state
delete.description:
The database is unreachable and is listed under deleted-databases for seven days. Restore it there by immutable ID before purgeAt. Data, backups and keys are retained until then; permanent cleanup begins after that deadline. Branches are independent. Platform databases are protected. Authorization: Bearer <ts-auth project access token>. project_id must equal {project}; scope must grant the operation. {database} is the immutable database ULID or its name. A token narrowed to one database cannot reach another. Tokens for another project or database answer 404.

Required JWT scopes: databases:write.

parameters.name: X-TerraScale-Region-Pin
parameters.description: Optional single raw region ID. An empty, duplicate or malformed pin returns 421 invalid_region_pin and a pin naming another region 421 region_pin_mismatch, both before execution and with recovery guidance; behind the edge a mismatched pin also answers ts-replay: region=<pin>.

delete.summary: Deletes a database only if its immutable identity matches
delete.description:
expectedId must be a canonical uppercase ULID matching the database ID resolved from the name for this request. A mismatch answers 409 database_identity_mismatch before placement or deletion. Never fall back to unconditional DELETE on 404: older servers do not support this route. Matching deletion has the same home-region requirement, independent branches and durable replica-erasure behavior as deleteDatabase, including allRegions, without a placement PATCH. 204 moves the database to the seven-day deleted state, preserving its data, backups and keys until purgeAt. Restore by immutable ID through deleted-databases. This is not an atomic reset or replacement operation. Authorization: Bearer <ts-auth project access token>. project_id must equal {project}; scope must grant the operation. {database} is the immutable database ULID or its name. A token narrowed to one database cannot reach another. Tokens for another project or database answer 404.

Required JWT scopes: databases:write.

parameters.name: expectedId
parameters.description: The immutable database ID inspected by the caller; a canonical uppercase ULID.

get.summary: Lists databases in the seven-day deleted state
get.description:
Requires a project token without a database restriction. Deleted databases retain their data and backups until purgeAt. Restore by immutable ID in the region that accepted deletion; a reused name or exhausted database allowance returns 409. Restoration clears the previous TTL. Query: after (exclusive cursor from the previous page's next), limit (1 to 100, default 20). Items are in creation order.

Required JWT scopes: databases:read.

homeRegion.description: Transitional: old-field PATCH bumps the version on repeat and refuses with 409 move_in_progress while a move is pending; removed with move-home by category C23 of batch db4a5ba7 once every consumer sends regions. Cannot be combined with regions in a request.

placementVersion.description: Placement epoch; unchanged region-set updates retain it, membership and writer changes increase it.

regions.description: Selected regions in catalog order, sorted by region id. Order carries no meaning; a status entry identifies the writer with role writer.
